explanation: Matches erdosproblems.com/285 with Martin's positive answer. The minimal largest denominator f in an Egyptian-fraction representation of 1 with k + 1 distinct terms satisfies f = (1 + o(1))·e/(e - 1)·(k + 1). It is stated for all k admitting such a representation (excluding the impossible 2-term case), with f supplied as any function meeting the IsLeast specification. Writing o(1) as an exact equality is equivalent, since o is free.
